title: Star of the Week: Nate Sheppard
parts:
⭐ STAR OF THE WEEK

Nate Sheppard | RB | Duke | SO | 4⭐

16 carries, 131 yds, 2 TD + 12 catches, 93 yds at #5 Miami. 47.2 Fantrax pts, the best Week 11 line from a top-50 prospect in the Alpha Draft Signal.

His card 👇

🧬 Who he is

A 5'10", 195-lb back in his second year out of HS. In 2025: 1,132 rush yds and 11 TD in 14 games, plus 286 rec yds.

2026, 9 games before Week 11: 132.1 rush yds and 34.0 rec yds per game, on 60% of Duke's carries.

🧠 Why he's a star

Volume plus efficiency: his card grades him 98 on volume and 96 on route efficiency.

Now the #1 RB in the Alpha Draft Signal (last week: #3, preseason: #32).

Production comps on his card: Eno Benjamin (Arizona State '18) and Sean Tucker (Syracuse '21).

📅 Next: Clemson at Duke, Fri Nov 20, 7:30 PM ET.

First NFL Draft class he's eligible for: 2028.

224 scrimmage yds against a top-5 team. Does he top it against Clemson? 👇
